metadata.name: SpecTextsFiles
metadata.description: Spec article — prose fields (description / notes / intent / purpose / processing / handling / rule / meaning / note / reason, and a transition's condition) that point into a YAML texts file with {"md": "key"} and render as Markdown. Covers the paired-file rule and named files (relative, .texts.yaml only), dotted key paths, how the text renders on generated pages (plain-text fallback without markdown-it-py), the rules jsonui-doc validate enforces (measured output), how every reader receives the text (read_spec_file returns {md, text}; jsonui-test refuses an unresolved reference; search_specs does not search texts-file text), and when to keep prose inline. jsonui-cli 1.9.3+.

notes: 2026-09-28 — written for jsonui-cli 1.9.3 (texts files: jsonui-cli d500411 + 875ad0d; read_spec_file expansion: jsonui-mcp-server on the same branch). The validate block is pasted from runs of that build on a fixture spec with one texts-file defect per run; the page is not pinned to a released version until 1.9.3 is tagged and the deploy pin moves.

2026-09-29 — re-measured for jsonui-cli 1.9.3's widened fields and stricter validation (jsonui-cli 7e4c183f through 4f99e2bf): the accepted fields now include purpose / processing / handling / rule / meaning / note / reason (not under harnessConditions / canonicalDivergence) and condition (transitions only); a named file must be relative and end in .texts.yaml; an empty file part and YAML merge keys are refused; PyYAML / markdown-it-py are needed only by a spec with a reference; jsonui-test refuses an unresolved reference; a unit page without markdown-it-py falls back to plain text with one warning. The validate block was re-run on that build, one defect per run, with no collateral warning (the fixture's other references stay in use).
The site's own specs do not use texts files yet. Since the deploy pin reached v1.9.3 (now v1.9.5) the toolchain would accept them; none has been moved.

2026-09-30 — read_spec_file's expansion shipped in jsonui-mcp-server 2.15.0 (5a85869); the readers section now names that version and says 2.14.x and earlier return the reference as written. search_specs' role line on /tools/mcp now says it does not search texts-file text, as this page already did.
